meta.interpretation: Map which organizations sponsor multiple myeloma drug trials and which drugs each one studies, as a bipartite sponsor–drug network where an edge means a sponsor ran trials involving that drug.
assumptions: Limited to interventional trials with Drug or Biological interventions, so device/behavioral studies are excluded.
Restricted to trials starting from 2015 onward to reflect the current treatment landscape.
Drugs are grouped by NLM MeSH intervention terms rather than raw sponsor-written names, so brand and combination names merge.
Each side of the network is capped at its 25 most frequent entities, with edges requiring at least 3 shared trials, to keep the graph readable.
Sponsor means lead sponsor; collaborators are not shown.
meta.counting_semantics: An edge links a lead sponsor to a drug / intervention (mesh) that appear in the same trial; its weight is the number of such trials.
